description: AVTP and AVDECC: avb-avtp (AVTP common header, AAF decode + test-only encode, AEM stream-format codec with decodable(); design §10.1/§10.2 header part) and avb-avdecc (ADP, AECP AEM + MVU with in-flight/retry engine, ACMP, descriptor codecs and model, AEM JSON dump, controller discovery/enumeration/binder, our listener entity responder, Milan ACMP ListenerSm, derive(); §9). Depends on FEAT-002 (avb-core). Keeps the design §6.1 dependency graph: avb-avdecc depends only on avb-core and avb-avtp (+ serde/serde_json), NOT on avb-srp or avb-gptp. MSRP inputs (TA registered/changed/withdrawn, Talker Failed with failure code and an `a5: bool` the daemon computes from avb_srp::A5_FAILURE_CODES), the effective Domain, and gPTP data (GM id, asCapable, propagation delay, path trace) enter as plain data events/structs defined in avb-avdecc; the daemon (FEAT-005) translates. Logically follows FEAT-003 so the 802.1Q TA_WAIT finding is known.
steps: Create crates/avb-avtp (lib avb_avtp; deps avb-core; #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]): common (AVTP subtypes, stream header sv/version/mr/tv/tu/sp/evt/seq/stream_id/avtp_timestamp), aaf (decode with format/nsr/channels/bit_depth/stream_data_length; encode for test vectors only, not used by the daemon), stream_format (AEM u64 codec per §10.1: AAF fields, CRF and IEC 61883 decode for the dump only; nsr code table; decodable(): INT_32BIT depth 1-32 or INT_24BIT depth<=24, nsr in {44.1,48,88.2,96,176.4,192 kHz}, channels 1-64, spf 1-64, ut=0). Tests: AAF header vectors, format vectors 0x0205022002006000 and 0x0205021802006000, decodable() matrix.

Create crates/avb-avdecc (lib avb_avdecc; deps avb-core, avb-avtp, serde =1.0.229, serde_json =1.0.151; #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]): milan + constants modules with every command/status/descriptor/message code as a named const with an IEEE 1722.1-2021 / Milan v1.2 citation comment and a pinning test; adp (ENTITY_AVAILABLE/DEPARTING/DISCOVER codec, entity table with valid_time*2 expiry, reboot detection, loopback flag); aecp (AEM command/response codec, MVU GET_MILAN_INFO protocol id 00-1B-C5-0A-C1-00, in-flight engine: one per target, <=200 cmd/s pacing, u16 seq per controller, match on (target, seq, command_type), 250 ms + 1 retry, IN_PROGRESS -> 1 s capped 10 s, final timeouts recorded); acmp (codec; every ACMPDU to 91:E0:F0:01:00:00; A5_RESOURCE_STATUSES const list with citations).

avb-avdecc aem::{desc, model, json}: descriptor codecs for ENTITY, CONFIGURATION, AUDIO_UNIT, STREAM_INPUT/OUTPUT, AVB_INTERFACE, CLOCK_SOURCE, CLOCK_DOMAIN, STREAM_PORT_INPUT/OUTPUT, AUDIO_CLUSTER, AUDIO_MAP, LOCALE, STRINGS, CONTROL, JACK_INPUT/OUTPUT (unknown types stored raw); limits (64 configs, 1024/type, 64 formats, 64 rates, 1024 mappings) -> quirks 'limit exceeded'; AEM dump JSON with schema 'avb-aem-dump/1' and exactly the §9.2 top-level keys.

avb-avdecc controller (§9.2): discovery (ENTITY_DISCOVER at start, every 5 s until chosen, then 30 s), talker selection (--talker or the single entity with talker_stream_sources>0; zero/many -> error mapped to exit 6 by the daemon), enumeration walk over every configuration, dynamic state GET_* commands (NOT_IMPLEMENTED recorded, non-fatal), REGISTER_UNSOLICITED_NOTIFICATION + change log 'aem change: ...', CONTROLLER_AVAILABLE answered SUCCESS, Binder: audio talker set A (AAF current_format, ascending), unbound_by_design for non-AAF, refusal of undecodable and > S_max=16 (A[16..]) with the exact message, sequential CONNECT_RX per j (4500 ms timeout, 3 attempts 1 s apart, response matching rule, acmp_ctrl_unmatched incl. loopback echo), separate ACMP controller seq counter, GET_TX_STATE + GET_STREAM_INFO check (ADC-15), A-5 not_simultaneously_streamable classification.

avb-avdecc derive (§9.1, §9.3): listener_model(&TalkerAem) -> Result<ListenerModel, DeriveError> is the ONLY constructor of ListenerModel: STREAM_INPUT j <-> B[j], formats filtered by decodable(), rates copied from the 16R AUDIO_UNIT, AUDIO_UNIT rate vs format nsr mismatch -> error, channel names via AUDIO_MAP/clusters else '<stream name> ch<k>', reference_index(&ListenerModel) (lowest CLOCK_SYNC_SOURCE else 0, shared with avb-mediaclock), entity_id = EUI-64, entity_model_id = 0x024156 || 0x01 || fnv1a32(canonical model). No rate/channel/stream literal anywhere outside tests.

avb-avdecc entity (§9.3, §9.4): ADP advertise every 5 s valid_time 10 with the listed capabilities and GM id from gPTP status (re-advertise on GM change), ENTITY_DEPARTING on shutdown, not advertising/answering before the model exists; AECP responder for every listed command (unlisted -> NOT_IMPLEMENTED, malformed -> BAD_ARGUMENTS), ACQUIRE_ENTITY and ENTITY GET_COUNTERS decided from Milan v1.2 text with a citation comment + test (record the decision in phase1a-impl-verification.md), LOCK_ENTITY 60 s, SET_STREAM_FORMAT/SET_SAMPLING_RATE STREAM_IS_RUNNING when bound, GET_STREAM_INFO Milan extended, GET_AVB_INFO with the effective Domain msrp_mappings, GET_COUNTERS from atomics, unsolicited notifications (<=16 controllers, counters <=1/s), TalkerSm slot returning NOT_SUPPORTED; acmp_listener::ListenerSm exactly per the §9.4 transition table (every row, timers as named consts with citations, shared PROBE_TX seq counter, fallback after probe_cycles==3, last_available_index rules, TA_WAIT 2 s edge subject to the FEAT-003 802.1Q finding), actions out (declare/withdraw Listener, SetStreamFilter, stream table) as data for the daemon.

avb-avdecc tests (§14.1 avb-avdecc row, every item): ADP/AECP/ACMP vectors, descriptor round-trips, enumeration vs a scripted fake talker (timeouts, IN_PROGRESS, NOT_IMPLEMENTED), derive with 3x4ch, 17 AAF (refusal), and 2 AAF around a CRF at index 1, ACMP addressing, TA-vs-PROBE_TX mismatch, A-5 classification incl. a non-member, entity responder per command, one test per ListenerSm row (named after it) incl. all rev-4/rev-5 rows, the 9.2-12.2 s fallback window with a simulated clock, controller sequential binding and unmatched-response cases, independent ACMP/AECP counters, GET_AVB_INFO adopted Domain, CLOCK_SOURCE location follows reference index, model-id stability.

Add crates to workspace members; update Cargo.lock offline. Append FEAT-004 to /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md; commit 'feat(avtp,avdecc): AAF/stream-format codecs, AVDECC controller + listener entity (phase1a FEAT-004)'.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p avb-avtp -p avb-avdecc --locked passes with one test per §9.4 ListenerSm row
Every ACMPDU encoded by the crate targets 91:E0:F0:01:00:00 (test asserts it)
ListenerModel is constructed only in avb_avdecc::derive; no rate/channel/stream-count literals in non-test code other than S_max=16 and the nsr table
clippy -D warnings clean; no I/O, clocks or threads in either crate
findings: DONE. avb-avtp (common/aaf/stream_format, 11 tests) and avb-avdecc (constants, milan, adp, acmp, aecp inflight engine, aem::{model,desc,json}, derive, controller binder, entity + acmp_listener ListenerSm, 87 tests) implemented per design §9/§10.1/§10.2. One test per §9.4 ListenerSm row plus fallback window, two reboots and rev-5 entry rows. AS-7 decisions recorded in phase1a-impl-verification.md: ACQUIRE_ENTITY and ENTITY GET_COUNTERS both NOT_IMPLEMENTED (Milan v1.2 §5.4.2.1 / §5.4.3) with citation consts + tests. Both crates added to workspace members; Cargo.lock regenerated offline (42 pkgs). AVDECC_MULTICAST re-exported from avb-core. Full gate green: fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace --locked, C++ tg3 97 + i210 341, dext xcodebuild 0 warnings, package.sh --adhoc (CFBundleVersion 283.0.1). Acceptance criterion 3 verified: no rate/channel/stream literals outside tests except S_max=16 and the nsr table.
